name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A short hint for a control on hover and keyboard focus, and on tap for touch users when needed.

when: Naming an icon button or adding a short hint.

instead.when: The content is interactive or long.

builtIn: Opens on keyboard focus too; touch users can tap with openOnTouch.
youProvide: Content that is a hint, never the only place important information lives.
